description: One hotel's details (address, coordinates, stars, rating, photos, description, facilities, check-in and check-out times, parking) and, when dates are given, every bookable room for them: offer_id, room name, board, refundable and the free cancellation deadline, total, per night, taxes included and taxes at the property, and a book_url where a person can fill in the guest form. Prices are the total for the whole stay for one room, in the currency asked (EUR by default), as Nuitee, the booking partner and merchant of record, charges them, with the taxes Nuitee collects included. Taxes and fees paid at the property (often a city or tourist tax) are listed separately in taxes_at_property and are not in the total.

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after check-in.

children.description: Ages of children in the room, if any.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.

title: Get hotel
